prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED TEAL flat color field — think #2E8B8B, a bright
blue-green tropical-reef color that is CLEARLY DISTINCT from the deep
navy of the ocean tile. Think Catan's hills/forest tile brightness but
in a teal hue — confidently pigmented, reading as SHALLOW CORAL WATER,
not deep water, not grey. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-
edge with this one teal color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO
paper border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO coral, NO
kelp. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within the same teal
hue. A region-fill swatch, not a tile with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Saturated flat teal color field filling the entire 1024x1024 square edge to edge, corner to corner, styled as a vivid board-game terrain tile in the manner of Settlers of Catan. Bold bright blue-green wash, approximately the hue of shallow tropical reef water — a confident pigmented teal, clearly warmer and lighter than deep navy ocean, reading immediately as distinct shallow-reef terrain. The whole image is one unified teal color plane with only the faintest brushstroke texture variation within the same hue, suggesting paint applied broadly with a wide flat brush. No hex outline, no border, no vignette, no coral, no kelp, no figures, no horizon. Pure saturated region-fill swatch, fresh and vivid, comic-book map register.
